name: Provo Network+
description: Provo by MyComputerCareer: exam readiness for CompTIA Network+ (N10-009). Acronyms, OSI model, ports, subnetting, media and wireless, security, troubleshooting, tools and commands, question qualifiers, performance-based questions, mini-exams, and a one-page cram sheet. To add it, choose Tools > Provo Network+ > Add Provo Network+ note. It creates a note named Provo Network+ and opens it in the full-width tool.
